new_today_news.headline: Google and American Airlines announce three-year SAF procurement agreement
new_today_news.summary: Google announced a three-year agreement to purchase SAF certificates associated with 35 million gallons of sustainable aviation fuel, with American Airlines taking physical delivery at Chicago O'Hare. The deal demonstrates book-and-claim accounting in the growing SAF market.

backfill_news.headline: GFL Environmental CEO: Business is undervalued with strategies to unlock growth
backfill_news.summary: CEO Patrick Dovigi stated at the Waste Leadership Summits investor day that GFL Environmental is undervalued and has strategies to further unlock growth, noting a large gap between GFL's valuation and that of its peer group. The company's most significant move is its announced $4.6 billion acquisition of Secure Waste Services.

backfill_news.headline: Tanker Truck Compliance: DOT Regulations, Inspections & Safety Protocols
backfill_news.summary: Article covers DOT tanker compliance requirements including inspection frequencies and penalties. Discusses how 37% of tanker violations relate to inspection and marking failures, with $25K+ average annual penalties for recurring HazMat compliance gaps.
